welcome.title: How can I help you?
welcome.body: Let's find a suitable vehicle or answer questions about your trip.

progress.searching: MoveVN is looking for an answer…
progress.uncertain: The connection was interrupted. Your message is kept; MoveVN will check the status again.
progress.committed: The result was recorded. MoveVN is syncing the details…
progress.stale: The status could not be confirmed. You can check again; your message is kept as is.

staff.waiting: Your request was sent. You can keep messaging while waiting for staff.
staff.active: Staff has joined. Continue the conversation here.
staff.confirmPlaceholder: What do you need help with?

errors.connectFailed: Could not connect to the server. Please try again.
errors.acceptedButUnloaded: Your message was received. The result could not be loaded; please check the status again.
errors.sendUnconfirmed: Could not confirm that the message was received. Retrying keeps the same message ID.
errors.handoff: Could not transfer your request. Please try again.
errors.quickBook: Could not open quick booking. Please try again.
errors.fallback: Could not answer right now. Please try again or talk to staff.

codes.AI_SCHEMA_NOT_READY: The assistant is being updated and is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.
codes.AI_OUT_OF_SCOPE: I can help with vehicles, bookings, payments and MoveVN policies. Which part would you like help with?
codes.ASSISTANT_CONFLICT: The conversation just changed or still has a message in progress. Please check the status and try again.
codes.AI_STATE_SYNC_PENDING: The result is still syncing. Please check the status before sending again.
codes.AI_QUEUE_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: The queue is taking too long. Your message was not received; please try again later.
codes.AI_QUEUE_BUSY: The queue is full. Your message is kept; please try sending again shortly.
codes.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The assistant is not connected to AI. Please try again later or contact staff.
codes.AI_INVALID_KEY: The assistant is having a connection issue. Please try again later or contact staff.
codes.AI_RATE_LIMITED: I'm receiving many requests and can't answer immediately. Please wait a moment and try again.
codes.AI_TIMEOUT: This took longer than expected, so I couldn't answer in time. Please try again; your rental details are still in the conversation.
codes.AI_SOURCE_STALE: The policy has been updated. Please ask again to get the latest information.
codes.AI_NO_EVIDENCE: I don't have enough verified information to answer this. Please share more details about the vehicle, booking or policy you need.
codes.AI_PROVIDER_ERROR: Could not connect to the assistant. Please try again later or contact staff.
codes.AI_INVALID_RESPONSE: I didn't receive a valid answer. Please try again or ask staff for help.
codes.AI_MISSING_SOURCES: I couldn't verify the policy source for this answer. You can ask again or request staff help.
codes.AI_INVALID_SOURCE: The policy source needs to be checked again. Please ask again or request staff help.
codes.AI_PROCESSING_ERROR: Something went wrong while processing the question. Please try again or request staff help.

http.400: The request is invalid. Please check the content and try again.
http.401: Your session has expired. Please sign in again to continue.
http.403: You don't have permission to do this. You can contact staff for help.
http.404: The conversation or data could not be found. Please check again or start a new conversation.
http.413: The content is too long. Please shorten the message and try again.
http.422: The request is invalid. Please check the content and try again.
